answer: Miscellaneous >> History & Biography Question ID: 63108 Country: India Title: Please Give the life chain of Shah walliyullah Dehlawi (ra) to Shah Muhammad Ilyas (ra) Question: Please give the life chain of Shah Wali Allah of Delhi (RA) to Shah Muhammad Ilyas (RA) because I heard that Ilyas (RA) is the grandson of Shah Wali Allah of Delhi (RA). Is it correct? Please give the details. Answer ID: 63108 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 307/316/L=03/1437) Hadhrat Maulana Ilyas (RA) is not the grandson of Shah Waliullah of Delhi (RA). And if you mean to know about Shah Muhammad Ishaq (RA) he was the grandson of Shah Abdul Aziz (RA). Shah Abdul Aziz (RA) had adopted him and appointed him his deputy. So he took the place of his grandfather and kept on benefiting the people for a long time. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
